Source grey band0.043 has no supplied derivation; it is not the across-construct buffer-control SD (~0.1792 for10ORs). Describe as source-reported reference band, not independently verified noise estimate or biological-replicate uncertainty. Each construct/odor condition is one well.

Notion reports39 receptor/odor pairs pooled r=-0.18,p=0.28; exact DoOR vectors/correlation script not supplied. Preserve as reported exploratory analysis, not independent replication. Proposed3-5 wells is a future suggestion, not a power justification or completed experiment.

Notion describes integer operation, but the reviewed public source contains no matching Brian2/integer PN-KC-MBON engine. Existing four-receptor hardware backend is a Pearson reference-pattern comparator. Do not equate it with deployed/trained spiking network or measured speed/power.

ALLN and DAN/RPE elements in network schematic are explicitly outside the experiments reported. New generated conceptual pathway replaces the uncredited article-derived anatomy illustration; do not infer anatomical measurements or network performance from either schematic.

External metal-oxide data and published DoOR consensus vectors are not independent AeroSense cell measurements or validated banana/mold detection. Cross-dataset performance and hardware validation remain separate.

Preserving prose/figures does not supply missing raw feature/response exports,trained checkpoints,split IDs,seeds or matching engine. Keep this precise scope in methods/data availability rather than claiming full computational reproduction.
